set.pl: D. K. Smalling 80s, sec 5 T90N R13W (Mount Vernon Twp), 1910 Black Hawk atlas; about 7 mi N of Cedar Falls.
pinev: 1910 Atlas of Black Hawk Co, Mount Vernon Twp plate (T90N R13W): 'D. K. Smalling 80' twice in sec 5, the W strip ('Glenview Farm') and the S part. BLM PLSS sec 5 = 42.6287-42.6425, -92.4161 to -92.3963.
Owner on the plat, two parcels; the crib and granary site is not fixed.
set.t: Smalling had two 80s in sec 5 on the 1910 atlas; the old granary and crib site is on one of them. Granary and crib sites spread coins: grid around the old farmstead. Access: private.

src: Atlas of Black Hawk County, Iowa (1910), Mount Vernon Twp plate (UIowa Digital Library)

set.pl: Callahan land, sec 31 T98N R3W (Lafayette Twp), 1917 Allamakee atlas directory; about 7 mi SW of Lansing.
pinev: 1917 Atlas of Allamakee Co, Lafayette Twp farm directory p.16: Ed. Callahan 119.59 ac sec 31 and H. Callahan 40 ac sec 31, heirs on the old Patrick Callahan farm. BLM PLSS sec 31 T98N R3W = 43.2541-43.2687, -91.2501 to -91.2306.
Heirs' names from a directory, not a plat drawing; the 1886 plat is unreadable.
set.t: Found, but plowed caches scatter: the 1921 jar came out of a field on the Callahan land in sec 31. Access: private.

src: Atlas of Allamakee County, Iowa (1917), Lafayette Twp farm directory (UIowa Digital Library)
